# Miami Pure Plumbing

Miami Pure Plumbing is a marketing, coordination, and lead generation platform for water treatment and water heater installations in Miami-Dade County, Florida. It is NOT a licensed plumbing contractor and does not perform plumbing work. All installations are performed by independent, state-certified Florida plumbing contractors holding CFC or PMC licenses and carrying liability insurance. Customers never pay Miami Pure Plumbing: contracting, warranties, and payment happen directly between the homeowner and the assigned licensed contractor at the published package price.

- Website: https://miamipureplumbing.com/
- Phone / Text: (786) 807-0105
- Email: miamipureplumbing@yahoo.com
- Service area: Miami-Dade County, Florida

## Packages (fixed published prices, plus applicable sales tax & local fees)

- Under-Sink Reverse Osmosis — 5-stage drinking water system, dedicated chrome faucet, professional under-counter installation: $1,200
- Standard 50-Gal Water Heater — high-efficiency electric tank replacement, includes HVHZ Miami-Dade municipal permit, thermal expansion tank, drain pan, and haul-away of old equipment: $1,999
- Tankless Water Heater Upgrade — endless hot water (electric or gas), compatibility assessment, full permit management and inspection coordination: $3,299
- Whole-Home Softening & Filter — complete house water conditioning, catalytic carbon and resin tank, eliminates hard water scale: $4,499

## Key facts

- Miami-Dade tap water comes from the Biscayne Aquifer and typically measures 12 to 15 grains per gallon (GPG) of hardness.
- Water heater package prices include the required HVHZ Miami-Dade municipal permit and inspection coordination; the assigned licensed contractor pulls the permit under their license.
- Booking through Miami Pure Plumbing costs the customer nothing extra; the installing contractor pays a marketing fee.
